en.title: Best Drones 2026
en.description: Ten consumer drones ranked for 2026 after the FCC Covered List reshaped what you can legally buy, scoring image quality, flight time, obstacle avoidance and availability separately, from the $2,699 DJI Mavic 4 Pro to the $199 DJI Neo 2.

zh-tw.title: 最佳空拍機 2026
zh-tw.description: 十台消費級空拍機依 2026 年美國 FCC 禁令後的新局排名，畫質、續航、避障與「還買不買得到」各自獨立評分，從六萬二的 DJI Mavic 4 Pro 到六千出頭的 DJI Neo 2。

en.description: A 1-inch 50MP sensor, forward LiDAR obstacle sensing and 4K/60 HDR in a body that stays under the 250g FAA registration threshold, authorized before the December 2025 FCC cutoff and now selling for as little as $683.

zh-tw.description: 1 吋 5000 萬畫素大底加上前向 LiDAR 避障，4K 60p HDR，起飛重量壓在 249 公克以下，在台灣飛不用登錄，而且它是在 2025 年 12 月美國禁令生效前就拿到認證的機型，現在買最安全。

en.description: Dual cameras pairing a 1-inch wide with a 70mm medium telephoto, 45 minutes of flight time and omnidirectional sensing, which makes it the aircraft I hand to anyone shooting real client work on a travel budget.

zh-tw.description: 雙鏡頭配置，1 吋主鏡加 70mm 中長焦，續航 45 分鐘、全向避障，接案拍風景或婚攝空景這台就夠用了，是台灣代理商公司貨裡最實用的中階機。

en.description: A 1/1.3-inch 50MP camera, 4K/60 HDR, 16km video transmission and up to 50 minutes of flight with the extended battery, launched June 2026 at $429 and reaching US buyers through Amazon and third-party sellers.

zh-tw.description: 1/1.3 吋 5000 萬畫素、4K 60p HDR、16 公里圖傳，換大電池可以飛到 50 分鐘，2026 年 6 月才發表，售價 429 美元，台灣目前沒有正式代理，要走代購或轉賣管道。

en.description: The cheapest way into a genuinely modern drone, with omnidirectional obstacle sensing plus forward LiDAR, a 2-axis gimbal, 4K/60 video and palm takeoff, all at NT$6,290 in Taiwan.

zh-tw.description: 六千出頭就能買到全向避障加前向 LiDAR，還有兩軸雲台跟 4K 60p，手掌一放就起飛，說真的這個價格帶以前根本不敢想，第一台空拍機從這裡入手最划算。

en.description: An 8K self-flying camera built around subject tracking instead of manual piloting, with propeller guards that let it launch from your hand and follow you through trail runs and ski runs.

zh-tw.description: 8K 自動跟拍飛行相機，整台設計就是為了追著你跑，全罩式槳葉護框可以直接從手上起飛，跑山、滑雪、衝浪這種一個人出門的場景特別好用，台灣有官方代理。

en.description: A triple-camera flagship with a 100MP 4/3 Hasselblad main sensor and a genuine 168mm optical telephoto, the best image quality you can fly, sold in the US through B&H, Adorama and Amazon rather than DJI's own store.

zh-tw.description: 三鏡頭旗艦，4/3 吋 1 億畫素 Hasselblad 主鏡加上真正的 168mm 光學長焦，畫質天花板就是這台，台灣有公司貨，單機六萬二起跳，接商業案才值得。

en.description: The world's first 8K 360 drone, with one lens above the airframe and one below so the propellers vanish from the stitched sphere, letting you reframe the shot after landing instead of aiming during flight.

zh-tw.description: 全球第一台 8K 360 度空拍機，機身上下各一顆鏡頭，接圖之後槳葉會自動消失，等於飛的時候不用想構圖，回家再決定要看哪個方向，Insta360 團隊做的，玩法完全不一樣。

en.description: Folding full-coverage propeller guards over a 1/1.3-inch sensor with 10-bit recording, sub-250g, and a palm launch that makes it the safest drone to hand to someone who has never flown.

zh-tw.description: 可折疊的全罩式槳葉保護框加 1/1.3 吋感光元件、支援 10-bit，重量壓在 249 公克以下，掌上起飛，帶新手或帶小孩玩這台最不用擔心撞到人。

en.description: The FPV drone that gives you the diving, banking feel of a racing quad with Goggles 3 and the Motion Controller 3, and DJI has cut as much as $340 off the combo price this year.

zh-tw.description: 穿越機的爽感但沒有穿越機的學習曲線，配飛行眼鏡 3 跟穿越搖桿 3，俯衝跟壓彎的臨場感很到位，今年套裝降了不少，想玩第一人稱視角從這台開始就對了。

en.description: A 1-inch CMOS with an adjustable f/2.8 to f/11 aperture and 6K video, the last mainstream non-DJI camera drone from a major western-facing brand, now sold down through remaining reseller inventory.

zh-tw.description: 1 吋 CMOS 加上可變光圈 f/2.8 到 f/11、6K 錄影，規格對上 DJI Air 系列不落下風，不過原廠 2025 年 7 月就停產了，現在只剩通路庫存，買之前先確認保固怎麼算。

references.title: DJI Is Suing the FCC for Blocking Its Ability to Import and Sell in the U.S.
The DJI Ban: Everything You Need to Know
DJI Seeks Court Review as FCC Covered List Expansion Reshapes U.S. Drone Market
Potensic Atom 3 review: The brand's best beginner drone just got better
Potensic Atom 3 review: The affordable 4K drone that gets surprisingly close to DJI
Potensic unveils the upgraded Atom 3, but the same US barriers to entry currently apply
DJI Mini 5 Pro Drops To $683 At Amazon, Its Lowest Price Yet
Antigravity Unveils A1: The World's First 8K 360 Drone

en.commentary:
The most useful thing I can tell you about buying a drone in 2026 is that the ranking factor that moved to the top of my list is regulatory. On December 22, 2025 the FCC added DJI and every other foreign drone maker to its Covered List, which blocks new foreign-made aircraft from receiving the equipment authorization required for legal import and sale in the United States. DJI filed a petition for review in the Ninth Circuit on February 20, 2026 and that case is still open. The practical result is that the drone you can buy today is a drone that cleared authorization before the cutoff, and that pool shrinks every month as retail inventory sells through.

That is why the DJI Mini 5 Pro takes the top spot. It carries a 1-inch 50MP sensor, forward LiDAR obstacle sensing and a takeoff weight under 250g that keeps you clear of FAA registration, and it was authorized before the deadline. Street price has already dropped to $683 on Amazon against a $759 list, which tells me retailers are clearing units fast.

The Potensic Atom 3 earns third place because it demonstrates how the rule actually works. Potensic shipped it in June 2026 at $429 with a 1/1.3-inch 50MP camera, 4K/60 HDR, 16km transmission and up to 50 minutes of flight on the extended battery. The rule follows country of manufacture, so the Atom 3 landed on the restricted side alongside DJI and reaches American buyers through Amazon and third-party sellers. Anyone shopping for a DJI alternative on political grounds should understand that first.

My advice if you are on the fence: buy the model you want now. The FCC extended the firmware update waiver for already-authorized foreign aircraft through at least January 1, 2029, so today's purchase comes with a defined support runway. In a market where supply is the binding constraint, waiting for a better price works against you.

highlights.title: Availability is the number one spec on a drone right now
highlights.body: I score every aircraft here on whether you can still legally buy it and how long it stays supported, and I weight that as heavily as image quality. The FCC Covered List addition on December 22, 2025 froze the roster of foreign drones eligible for US equipment authorization, which makes the shelf a closing window. The Mavic 4 Pro is the clearest illustration: it produces the best footage of anything on this list by a wide margin, and it still lands at sixth because you buy it through B&H, Adorama and Amazon while DJI's own US store stays out of the transaction. If you are choosing between two drones and one of them cleared authorization before the cutoff, that alone is worth more than a stop of dynamic range.

highlights.title: The DJI Mini 5 Pro is the correct buy for almost everyone reading this
highlights.body: A 1-inch 50MP sensor at 249g used to be a contradiction, and DJI resolved it. You get 4K/60 HDR, forward LiDAR for obstacle sensing in low light, and a weight class that keeps recreational flyers clear of FAA registration and clear of Taiwan's own registration threshold. The reason I put it above the Air 3S comes down to what actually happens on a trip: the Mini 5 Pro goes in the bag every time, and the Air 3S gets left at the hotel about half the time. A camera you carry beats a camera you own. At $683 on Amazon it also happens to be the best price-per-capability point in the entire category.

highlights.title: The Potensic Atom 3 proves the restriction follows the factory, and that changes how you shop
highlights.body: Potensic launched the Atom 3 in June 2026 with a 1/1.3-inch 50MP camera, 4K/60 HDR, 16km video transmission and up to 50 minutes of flight time on the extended battery, for $429. It is a genuinely good aircraft, and it hit the same wall DJI did, so US buyers get it through Amazon and third-party channels while Potensic's own store sits out. I keep seeing buyers reach for a non-DJI brand assuming that solves the regulatory question, and the Atom 3 is the cleanest evidence that the rule is drawn around country of manufacture. Buy it because 4K/60 HDR at $429 is excellent value, which is the real reason it belongs at third.

highlights.title: The Antigravity A1 is the most genuinely new idea in consumer drones since the folding Mavic
highlights.body: One 360 lens sits above the airframe and one sits below, so stitching removes the propellers and the aircraft entirely and leaves you a complete sphere. That inverts the whole workflow. You fly the path and choose the framing afterward on a laptop, which means a single battery yields several usable shots from angles you would never have thought to aim at in the moment. At $1,599 it costs more than an Air 3S and delivers a lower per-pixel image quality, and I still think it is the most interesting $1,599 in this category for anyone making short-form video. Costco has run the Essential Bundle at $1,359.99, which is the number to watch.

highlights.title: Spend NT$6,290 before you spend NT$62,000, because most people quit at week three
highlights.body: The DJI Neo 2 has omnidirectional obstacle sensing with forward LiDAR, a 2-axis gimbal, 4K/60 video and palm takeoff at NT$6,290 in Taiwan. Five years ago that feature list belonged to a NT$30,000 aircraft. I rank it fourth overall and first among everything I would recommend as a first drone, because the honest pattern with new pilots is that enthusiasm outlasts the first crash roughly half the time. Fly the Neo 2 for a season, learn where you are actually allowed to launch, find out whether you enjoy the editing more than the flying, and then decide whether a Mini 5 Pro or an Air 3S earns the money.

zh-tw.commentary:
老實說，2026 年買空拍機最該先搞懂的一件事跟感光元件沒什麼關係。2025 年 12 月 22 日，美國 FCC 把 DJI 以及所有外國空拍機廠商列入 Covered List，這代表新的外國製機型拿不到在美國合法進口與販售所需的設備認證。DJI 在 2026 年 2 月 20 日向第九巡迴上訴法院提出覆核，案子到現在還沒結。實際結果就是，現在買得到的機型，都是在那個時間點之前就拿到認證的，而這個池子隨著通路庫存賣完，每個月都在縮小。

台灣讀者這裡要注意一個落差。台灣沒有跟進這條禁令，DJI 在台灣有正式代理、有公司貨、有保固，所以美國那邊的缺貨與加價在台灣不會直接發生。但這件事還是會影響你，因為原廠的研發資源、新機發表節奏跟長期韌體支援，都跟美國市場綁在一起。

這就是我把 DJI Mini 5 Pro 放第一的理由。1 吋 5000 萬畫素、前向 LiDAR 避障、4K 60p HDR，起飛重量壓在 249 公克以下，台灣飛不用登錄，美國也在認證截止前過關。美國那邊 Amazon 已經從 759 美元掉到 683 美元，台灣公司貨 NT$22,090，一台 iPhone 的錢買到現在體積重量比最好的機型，很值得。

Potensic Atom 3 我排第三，因為它把這條規則的邏輯講得最清楚。2026 年 6 月推出，429 美元，1/1.3 吋 5000 萬畫素、4K 60p HDR、16 公里圖傳、換大電池飛 50 分鐘，規格很硬，然後它一樣被擋在門外。這條規則看的是製造國，很多人以為換個非 DJI 的牌子就沒事了，Atom 3 就是最好的反證。台灣沒有正式代理，要走代購，這點買之前要想清楚。

講白了，如果你在猶豫，我的建議是想好型號就直接買。FCC 對已經取得認證的外國機型，把韌體更新豁免延長到至少 2029 年 1 月 1 日，等於你今天買的機器有明確的支援期限可以算。在一個供給端被卡住的市場裡，等降價這個習慣會害到你。

highlights.title: 現在買空拍機，第一順位規格是「還買不買得到」
highlights.body: 這份榜單裡我把「能不能合法買到、能被支援多久」這件事的權重拉到跟畫質一樣高。2025 年 12 月 22 日 FCC 的 Covered List 一加，等於把有資格取得美國認證的外國機型名單直接凍結，貨架上剩下的是一個正在關閉的窗口。Mavic 4 Pro 就是最清楚的例子，它的畫質在這份榜單裡遙遙領先，我還是把它排到第六，因為美國那邊得透過 B&H、Adorama 跟 Amazon 買，DJI 自家美國商店不賣。台灣雖然有公司貨，但零件供應與長期支援終究看原廠的全球盤，兩台在猶豫的時候，認證狀態這個欄位比多一級動態範圍值錢。

highlights.title: 看到這裡的人，九成應該直接買 DJI Mini 5 Pro
highlights.body: 1 吋 5000 萬畫素塞進 249 公克，這件事以前是互相矛盾的，DJI 把它解掉了。4K 60p HDR、前向 LiDAR 讓弱光避障真的能用、重量壓在台灣免登錄的門檻下。我把它排在 Air 3S 前面的理由很現實，出去玩的時候 Mini 5 Pro 每次都會被塞進包包，Air 3S 大概有一半的機率被留在民宿。帶得出門的相機贏過放在家裡的相機，這句話在空拍機上更成立。台灣公司貨 NT$22,090，以能力對價格來說，整個品類最甜的位置就是這台。

highlights.title: Potensic Atom 3 證明了這條規則看的是製造國
highlights.body: Potensic 在 2026 年 6 月推出 Atom 3，429 美元，1/1.3 吋 5000 萬畫素、4K 60p HDR、16 公里圖傳，換上大電池能飛到 50 分鐘。這是一台真的很好的機器，然後它撞上了跟 DJI 一模一樣的那道牆，美國買家只能走 Amazon 跟第三方賣家，原廠自己的商店反而出不了貨。我常看到有人為了避開法規問題刻意去找非 DJI 的牌子，Atom 3 就是最乾淨的反證。它值得買的理由很單純，429 美元有 4K 60p HDR 的規格 CP 值真的高，這才是它排第三的原因。台灣要代購，這點自己評估。

highlights.title: Antigravity A1 是折疊 Mavic 之後，消費級空拍機最有新意的一次
highlights.body: 機身上面一顆 360 鏡頭、下面一顆 360 鏡頭，接圖之後槳葉跟整台飛機都會消失，留給你一顆完整的球。這整個把工作流程翻過來了，你飛航線就好，構圖回家在筆電上再決定，等於一顆電池可以剪出好幾個你當下根本不會想到要對準的角度。1,599 美元比 Air 3S 貴，單畫素畫質也比不上，我還是覺得對做短影音的人來說，這是這個價位裡最有意思的一台。美國 Costco 的 Essential Bundle 出過 1,359.99 美元，台灣要代購，想入手的話盯這個數字。

highlights.title: 先花六千再考慮六萬，因為多數人第三週就放棄了
highlights.body: DJI Neo 2 有全向避障加前向 LiDAR、兩軸雲台、4K 60p，還能手掌起飛，台灣 NT$6,290。五年前這串規格是三萬塊機器的配備。我把它排在總榜第四，但在「第一台空拍機」這個問題上它是我唯一的答案，因為新手的真實狀況是，熱情能撐過第一次炸機的大概只有一半。用 Neo 2 飛一季，把台灣哪些地方能飛、遙控無人機管理規則怎麼看搞清楚，順便確認你到底喜歡飛還是喜歡剪，再決定要不要往 Mini 5 Pro 或 Air 3S 加碼。

references.title: DJI Scores Its Biggest Legal Win in Years, New Drone Tariffs Hit 100%, and the HOVERAir Versa Clears the FCC
Drone news and views covering DJI, Skydio, Parrot and more

en.commentary:
Two things happened this week that change how I would spend money on a drone, and only one of them is good news. On August 14 a federal appeals court sent DJI's Pentagon blacklist case back to the lower court, ruling that the earlier decision leaned too heavily on the unclassified record. That is the strongest legal position DJI has held in years and it lowers the odds of the worst-case outcome, which was a hard availability cliff for the most capable camera drones on the market.

The bad news is pricing. New tariffs on Chinese-made drones hit 100 percent, and that lands on almost every model in this top ten. My read is that the tariff compresses the value column across the board rather than reordering it, because the same duty applies to DJI, Potensic and HoverAir alike. What it does change is which model inside a lineup makes sense. When every price roughly doubles, buying an older platform stops being the safe budget move, which is why I moved the Avata 2 down on value this week.

The Mini 5 Pro stays first and the case for it is stronger under tariffs, not weaker. It carries a one-inch sensor, sits under the 249-gram registration threshold in most jurisdictions, and folds into a jacket pocket. When the price of every drone doubles, the model you actually carry is the one worth owning, and sub-250-gram drones are the ones people carry.

HoverAir's Versa clearing the FCC is worth tracking. A handheld camera that also flies autonomously is a different product category, and if it ships at a sane price it will pressure the middle of this list.

highlights.title: The 100 percent tariff makes the Mini 5 Pro a better buy, not a worse one
highlights.body: When duties double the cost of every drone in the category, the deciding question becomes how often you actually fly the thing. The Mini 5 Pro carries a one-inch sensor under the 249-gram registration threshold and fits in a jacket pocket, so it gets flown. A heavier drone with marginally better specs sitting at home is pure sunk cost at these prices.

highlights.title: DJI's appeals court win removes the worst availability scenario
highlights.body: The August 14 ruling ordered the lower court to reconsider DJI's blacklist status on more than the unclassified record. That does not clear DJI, and it does meaningfully reduce the chance of an abrupt import shutdown that would have stranded owners without parts or firmware support. For anyone hesitating on a DJI purchase over availability risk, the risk premium just got smaller.

highlights.title: I dropped the Avata 2 on value this week
highlights.body: The Avata 2 is a 2024 platform and it now carries 2026 tariff pricing. Paying doubled duty on an older FPV airframe is the weakest allocation of money in this whole list, so its value sub-score comes down to 6.8. The cinewhoop experience it offers is still genuinely fun, and the entry price no longer matches what you get.

highlights.title: HoverAir Versa is the model to watch after FCC clearance
highlights.body: A handheld camera with the autonomous flight stack from the X1 series is a category that did not exist last year. If the Versa ships near the X1 Pro Max price band, it competes for the same buyer who wants footage without piloting skill, and that is the fastest-growing slice of this market. I will rank it once retail units are shipping.

zh-tw.commentary:
這週有兩件事會直接改變你該怎麼花這筆買空拍機的錢，其中只有一件是好消息。

8 月 14 日聯邦上訴法院把 DJI 對五角大廈黑名單的案子發回下級法院重審，理由是原判決過度依賴非機密資料。這是 DJI 這幾年拿到最強的一次法律進展，也把最壞劇本的機率壓下來，那個劇本是市面上最強的攝影空拍機突然斷貨。

壞消息是價格。中國製空拍機的新關稅拉到 100%，這份前十名幾乎每一台都被打到。我的判斷是關稅會整體壓縮 CP 值那一欄，排序本身不會亂掉，因為 DJI、Potensic、HoverAir 通通吃同一張稅單。真正改變的是同一個品牌裡該選哪一台。當價格全面翻倍，買舊平台就不再是安全的省錢做法，這也是我這週把 Avata 2 的 CP 值往下調的原因。

Mini 5 Pro 守第一，而且在關稅之下理由更充分。一吋感光元件、249 克以下免登記、外套口袋塞得進去。價格全面翻倍的時候，你真的會帶出門的那台才值得買，而 250 克以下就是那個會被帶出門的級距。台灣這邊更明顯，假日想飛就是騎車去河濱，重量差一點就是帶不帶的差別。

HoverAir Versa 通過 FCC 值得追蹤。手持相機加上自動飛行，這是新的產品類別，價格合理的話會直接衝擊這份榜單的中段。

highlights.title: 100% 關稅之下，Mini 5 Pro 反而更值得買
highlights.body: 當整個品類的價格都被稅翻倍，決策問題就變成你到底會飛幾次。Mini 5 Pro 一吋感光元件、249 克以下免登記、口袋放得下，所以它會被帶出門。規格好一點但重得多的機器留在家裡吃灰，在這個價位就是純浪費。

highlights.title: 上訴法院這一勝，把最糟的供貨劇本拿掉了
highlights.body: 8 月 14 日的裁定要求下級法院不能只看非機密資料重新審視 DJI 的黑名單狀態。這沒有替 DJI 平反，但確實降低了突然斷絕進口、讓現有機主拿不到零件與韌體支援的機率。原本因為供貨風險在猶豫的人，這個風險溢價變小了。

highlights.title: 這週我把 Avata 2 的 CP 值往下調
highlights.body: Avata 2 是 2024 年的平台，現在卻要吃 2026 年的關稅價。為一台舊 FPV 機體付翻倍的稅金，是這份榜單裡最不划算的一種花法，所以 CP 值子項降到 6.8。它的穿越機飛行體驗依然好玩，入手價已經配不上你拿到的東西。

highlights.title: HoverAir Versa 是通過 FCC 之後最該盯的一台
highlights.body: 把 X1 系列的自動飛行能力塞進一台手持相機，這是去年還不存在的品類。如果 Versa 的定價落在 X1 Pro Max 附近，它會直接搶走那群想要空拍畫面又不想學操控的買家，而這正是這個市場成長最快的一塊。等實際出貨我會把它排進來。

en.commentary:
The DJI Mini 5 Pro holds first place and the reason is regulatory rather than technical. At under 250 grams it sits below the registration threshold in most jurisdictions, which in Taiwan means you can fly it for recreation without the paperwork a heavier aircraft requires. Combined with a 9.3 imaging score and a 9.4 safety score, it delivers most of what a larger drone does without the administrative friction.

The DJI Air 3S at number two has the best flight performance in the mainstream tier at 9.4, with dual cameras giving you two focal lengths in one aircraft. If you have already registered and want more capability, this is where I would step up.

The Potensic Atom 3 at number three carries a 9.6 value score and a 9.2 flight score, which makes it the alternative worth considering if you want sub-250g capability at a lower price.

The DJI Mavic 4 Pro posts a 9.9 imaging score, the highest in this ranking, and its 6.4 availability score reflects supply constraints that keep it out of many buyers' hands.

No changes this week.

highlights.title: Staying under 250 grams is why the Mini 5 Pro leads
highlights.body: Weight below the registration threshold changes what you can do on an ordinary weekend. In Taiwan that means recreational flight without the registration process a heavier aircraft triggers. A 9.3 imaging score means you give up very little for that freedom, which is why this remains my default recommendation.

highlights.title: Air 3S is the step up for people who already registered
highlights.body: A 9.4 flight score with dual cameras covering two focal lengths gives you framing options a single-camera drone cannot match. Wind resistance is noticeably better as well, which matters on a coastal shoot. If the paperwork is already done, this is where the extra money buys real capability.

highlights.title: Availability is a real specification, and it separates the Mavic 4 Pro from its score
highlights.body: A 9.9 imaging score is the best here, and a 6.4 availability score is what keeps it at sixth place. A camera you cannot buy delivers nothing. When supply improves this aircraft deserves a higher position, and until then I recommend planning around what you can actually order.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Mini 5 Pro 守住第一，理由跟法規有關，跟技術規格反而沒那麼有關。

250 公克以下讓它落在多數國家的註冊門檻之下，在台灣就是你可以拿它做娛樂飛行，不用跑比較重的機型需要的那些文件。搭配 9.3 分影像跟 9.4 分安全性，它給你的東西跟大機幾乎一樣，行政摩擦卻少很多。

第二名 DJI Air 3S 在主流級距裡飛行表現最好，9.4 分，雙鏡頭讓你一台飛機有兩個焦段。如果你已經完成註冊、想要更多能力，我會從這裡往上升級。

第三名 Potensic Atom 3 的 CP 值 9.6 分、飛行 9.2 分，想用比較低的價格拿到 250 公克以下的能力，它值得考慮。

DJI Mavic 4 Pro 的影像 9.9 分是全榜最高，而 6.4 分的可取得性反映的是供貨吃緊，很多人根本買不到。

這週不動。

highlights.title: 壓在 250 公克以下，這就是 Mini 5 Pro 領先的原因
highlights.body: 重量落在註冊門檻以下，直接改變你一個普通週末能做什麼。在台灣就是娛樂飛行不用跑比較重的機型會觸發的註冊程序。9.3 分的影像代表你為了這份自由幾乎沒有犧牲什麼，所以它一直是我的預設推薦。

highlights.title: 已經完成註冊的人，往上就是 Air 3S
highlights.body: 9.4 分飛行表現加上涵蓋兩個焦段的雙鏡頭，構圖選項是單鏡頭機給不了的。抗風性也明顯更好，海邊拍攝就很有感。文件都跑完了的話，多花的錢在這裡換到的是實質能力。

highlights.title: 買不買得到也是規格，這讓 Mavic 4 Pro 的名次跟它的分數對不上
highlights.body: 9.9 分影像是這裡最好的，而 6.4 分的可取得性把它壓在第六名。買不到的相機等於零。供貨改善之後這台值得更高的位置，在那之前，我建議照你真的訂得到的東西來規劃。

en.commentary: The DJI Mini 5 Pro holds first because it puts a genuinely capable camera under the registration weight threshold, and that regulatory position matters more than any spec comparison. A drone you can fly without extra paperwork is a drone you actually take out. Its obstacle sensing has closed most of the gap to the larger models, which used to be the real reason to size up. The Air 3S at 8.7 remains the right choice for anyone doing paid work, since dual cameras give you framing options in a single flight and the longer battery covers a real shoot. Potensic's Atom 3 at 8.5 is the value entry and it is the drone I recommend to people learning, because crashing something affordable is part of the process. DJI Neo 2 at 8.4 serves a different purpose entirely as a follow camera that needs no controller. Availability remains a genuine concern in this category, since import restrictions have made some models hard to source in various markets. Check local stock and regulations before you commit to a platform, because a drone you cannot legally fly where you live is worth nothing regardless of its ranking here.

highlights.title: Staying under the weight threshold is the real feature
highlights.body: The Mini 5 Pro puts a capable camera below registration limits, so it flies without extra paperwork. That regulatory position determines how often a drone actually leaves the bag, which matters more than any spec comparison.

highlights.title: Paid work needs the Air 3S
highlights.body: Dual cameras give framing options within a single flight and the longer battery covers a real shoot. For anyone billing for aerial footage, those two attributes turn a hobby drone into a working tool.

highlights.title: Learn on something you can afford to crash
highlights.body: Potensic's Atom 3 delivers competent flight at a price that makes the inevitable early crash survivable. Starting here builds the stick skills that protect a more expensive aircraft later.

highlights.title: Check local availability and rules first
highlights.body: Import restrictions have made some models hard to source, and flight regulations vary sharply by country. Confirm both before committing to a platform, because a drone you cannot legally fly where you live has no value.

zh-tw.commentary:
DJI Mini 5 Pro 守第一，因為它把一顆真的能用的相機塞進免登記重量門檻以下，而這個法規位置比任何規格比較都重要。不用多跑一輪文件就能飛的機器，你才會真的帶出門。它的避障已經追上大機種一大截，而那本來正是大家升級的理由。

Air 3S 拿 8.7，接案的人選它。雙鏡頭讓你單趟飛行就有不同焦段可選，電池也撐得完一場真正的拍攝。

Potensic Atom 3 8.5 是入門的 CP 值選擇，我推薦給正在學的人，因為摔掉一台便宜的本來就是學習過程的一部分。DJI Neo 2 8.4 則是完全不同的用途，不用遙控器的跟拍機。

這個品類的取得性是真的要注意，進口限制讓某些型號在不同市場都不好買。決定平台之前先確認在地庫存跟法規，畢竟一台你在自己住的地方不能合法飛的空拍機，排名再高也沒有意義。

highlights.title: 壓在重量門檻以下才是真正的賣點
highlights.body: Mini 5 Pro 把一顆好相機放進免登記重量以下，飛之前不用多跑文件。這個法規位置決定了它多常真的被帶出門，比任何規格比較都關鍵。

highlights.title: 接案就要 Air 3S
highlights.body: 雙鏡頭讓單趟飛行就有多種構圖選擇，續航也撐得完一場真的拍攝。對靠空拍收費的人來說，這兩點把玩具變成生財工具。

highlights.title: 學飛請挑摔得起的機器
highlights.body: Potensic Atom 3 的飛行素質夠用，價格也讓早期那幾次必然的摔機不至於太痛。從這裡練起，桿量練出來之後才有本錢保護更貴的機器。

highlights.title: 先確認在地供貨跟法規
highlights.body: 進口限制讓部分型號很難買到，各國的飛行規定也差很多。決定平台之前把這兩件事查清楚，因為在你住的地方不能合法飛的空拍機價值等於零。
